req.title: Fetching completed tasks
req.statement: The system shall optionally filter tasks by completed status when a filter query parameter is supplied.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /tasks/?completed=true (or false) must filter tasks by completion status. I design tests covering: (1) positive EP — completed=true returns only completed tasks and excludes incomplete ones; (2) positive EP — completed=false returns only incomplete tasks; (3) negative NEG — invalid completed value yields HTTP 422; (4) BVA — no completed param returns all tasks (boundary: filter absent vs present); (5) DT — mixed dataset with both completed and incomplete tasks verifies exact filtering logic. Each test seeds its own data via POST, asserts exact status codes and exact response field values to kill operator-flip and boolean-negation mutations.

tests.name: test_filter_completed_true_returns_only_completed_tasks
preconditions: Two tasks exist: one completed=true, one completed=false
actions: POST /tasks/ with completed=true to create a completed task
POST /tasks/ with completed=false to create an incomplete task
expected: That task title matches the completed task seeded
trace: R-TASK-036: filter by completed=true must return only completed tasks
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_filter_completed_true_returns_only_completed_tasks():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Done Task", "completed": True})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Pending Task", "completed": False})
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    r = client.get("/tasks/?completed=true")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    tasks = r.json()
    assert len(tasks) == 1
    assert tasks[0]["completed"] == True
    assert tasks[0]["title"] == "Done Task"

test_filter_completed_true_returns_only_completed_tasks()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_no_completed_filter_returns_all_tasks():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task A", "completed": True})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task B", "completed": False})
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    r = client.get("/tasks/")

tests.name: test_filter_completed_true_excludes_all_incomplete_tasks
preconditions: Three tasks: two completed=true, one completed=false
actions: POST three tasks with mixed completed values
expected: No task with completed=false appears in response
trace: R-TASK-036: decision table — completed=true filter with multiple rows; verifies boolean filter logic and count
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_filter_completed_true_excludes_all_incomplete_tasks():
    client = TestClient(app)
    for title in ["Done 1", "Done 2"]:
        r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title, "completed": True})
        assert r.status_code == 201
    r3 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Not Done", "completed": False})
    assert r3.status_code == 201
    r = client.get("/tasks/?completed=true")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    tasks = r.json()
    assert len(tasks) == 2
    for t in tasks:
        assert t["completed"] == True
    titles = [t["title"] for t in tasks]
    assert "Not Done" not in titles

test_filter_completed_true_excludes_all_incomplete_tasks()
